newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines ravises 1996 full-year GNP, GDP rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippines ravises 1996 full-year GNP, GDP rates.

text.p: The Philippines has revised its 1996 full-year gross national product (GNP) growth to 6.94 percent from 6.84 percent announced earlier in the year.
The gross domestic product (GDP) growth was raised to 5.68 percent from 5.48 percent.
National Statistical Coordinating Board secretary general Romulo Virola said the agency underestimated the income earned by government offices last year.
On the other hand, it overestimated the contribution of workers' remittances leading to a smaller adjustment in GNP than in GDP.
